item.g:title: Impulse Anvil – Build Custom Impulse Responses from Two Sounds | Windows VST3
item.g:short_title: Build Custom Impulse Responses from Two Sounds
item.g:description: Impulse Anvil is a Windows 10/11 VST3 workstation for building new impulse responses from two IRs, recordings or found sounds. Shape each source, morph their time, spectral and stereo structure, audition the result through convolution, then bake it as a reusable standard WAV. The full license unlocks all six morph modes, mode-aware A-to-B Lerp, both Color rows, Texture Depth, waveform editing, visual EQ, width and level preparation, WAV export, and two activation seats. A library of 126 handmade IRs is included with the download and can also be explored in demo mode.
item.g:product_type: Audio Software > Audio Plugins > Convolution & Impulse Response Tools
